description: An oil-style painting of a bearded man in a dark grey hooded robe with a leather belt and pouch, bowing forward and holding a folded document. He faces a seated figure in white and gold papal vestments wearing a jewelled tiara, with red-robed cardinals standing around in a stone arched hall, and a bearded man in a pale robe behind him. The scene is edge to edge with no visible text, border or signature. Nothing is gory or nude.
